name: Brutalist mono
tagline: Two hard edges, block weight for progress, one yellow slab only when it is your turn.
mood: A letterpress job sheet: heavy, flat, unhurried, impossible to misread from across the room.
rationale: A tool glanced at a hundred times a day should be readable before it is read: this theme puts every row on two hard left edges (text at column 3, numbers at column 60), separates sections with exactly one blank line and a flush label (an inverse chip, or a slab for the two things that matter), and carries progress by glyph weight (░ todo, ▓ doing, █ done) so the plan column itself reads as a meter. That answers the spacing complaint directly: nothing floats, nothing touches, the gaps all mean the same thing, and the dim rules that blended into the rows are gone. Character comes from weight and rhythm, not decoration; colour is held back for meaning (gate ✓/✗, ? ! ~ on theme keys) and the one loud yellow slab appears at one place per site (the band's health cell, the pane's NEEDS YOU bar) and only while something waits on the person.
tokenMap: The engine cannot select a palette by theme (raw hex ignores the person's theme and there is no light/dark query), so `lightPalette` is for the mockup page only: the implementation uses ONE hex per token, each with a pinned foreground so the pair is self-contained on both themes. bg: the terminal's own background (nothing is painted; the hex is for the mockup page). fg: theme key `text`. dim: `dimColor` (theme key `inactive` where a colour is needed). accent: `#ffcf00` on both themes, used ONLY as a background: the two accent slabs are `Text backgroundColor="#ffcf00" color="#101010"` (terminal) or `Box backgroundColor="#ffcf00"` with `Text color="#101010"` (desktop/mobile); never as a text colour; the mockup writes `{accent}{inverse}` only because the markup has no background-accent tone (a real `inverse` on accent text would print white-on-yellow on light terminals, which is why the implementation does not use it). accent2: `#e8e8e8` on both themes, used only on desktop/mobile as the plain-slab/chip `Box backgroundColor` with the label pinned to `Text color="#101010"`; in the terminal the plain slabs and chips (title, PLAN, SIGNALS, LOG, active tab) are `Text inverse`, which flips to black-on-white on light terminals by itself. bg2: mockup-only; the implementation's hover background on step and needs rows is the `subtle` theme key (theme-following), no hex. success: theme key `success` (gate ✓, working `▌`, finished `█`). warning: theme key `warning` (`?` decision glyph, `~` drift, Ruling marker). error: theme key `error` (`!` health glyph as text, `!` blocker glyph, `✗` gate, blocked step). `!` is always error as text; yellow is only ever a background.
paneOverview: {warning}{bold}?{/}{/} D1 Bill per seat or per workspace?                       {dim}blocks B4{/}
{warning}~{/} commit 3f2a1bc not linked to a step                      {dim}3m{/}
{inverse} 1 OVERVIEW {/}  {dim}2{/} PLAN  {dim}3{/} LOG  {dim}n{/} NEEDS YOU 1  {dim}o{/} FILE  {dim}x{/} CLOSE
otherTabs: Plan: a ` PLAN ` chip, then every phase as a row on the same grid (`█ A API` 5/5 at col 60, `▌ B UI` 2/6, `░ C Docs` 0/7); folded phases are the row alone and the open one lists its steps exactly as the overview does. Log: a ` LOG ` chip, the time in the 6-wide label column at col 3 (`16:40`), text at col 9, a Ruling carrying `▌` in warning in the gutter so it stands out without colouring the sentence. Step details: the step's own weight glyph in the gutter (`▓`) before an inverse title slab from col 3 (`B3 Seat limit checks`), then ` STATUS ` ` COMMITS ` ` GATE ` ` AGENTS ` chips with label-column rows (`started`, `agent`, `tool`) and the same col-60 right column for shas and times. Needs you: the one accent NEEDS YOU slab at the top, each question a `?` (warning bold) in the gutter with the bold title at col 3, then `why`, `blocks`, `asked` in the label column, options as `[ PER SEAT ]` `[ PER WORKSPACE ]` Buttons with the recommended one `variant=primary`, and an answered item keeps its row with `Claude has it` in the right column. With nothing asked, the section is a plain ` NOTICED ` inverse chip: no yellow anywhere. Finished run: the gutter shows a plain `█` in success, the meter is all `█`, NEEDS YOU is absent, the header's right column reads `took 3h12m`.
glyphs: Step weight scale (monochrome, weight = progress): todo `░` dim · doing `▓` bold (the one animated cell) · done `█` with the title dim · blocked `!` error bold · skipped `·` dim. Current phase `▌` (a cursor: "here, now") on the phase row and in the chip strip `█A ▌B ░C` (done/current/todo, `░C` dim). Decision `?` warning bold, blocker `!` error bold, drift `~` warning: all three are plain text in the gutter; none sits on a slab. Health: working `▌` success and finished `█` success are plain glyphs with no slab; needs-you `!` and gate-red `✗` are the only states that get a 3-cell slab, and only on the band (` ! ` on accent with a pinned `#101010` foreground, ` ✗ ` as `inverse` error); in the pane header the same four glyphs are plain tone text in the gutter (`!` error bold). Gate keeps `✓`/`✗` in success/error. Meter cells: `█` filled, `░` empty, 10 cells in the band, columns−15 in the pane, fg not green (colour is for meaning only). Section labels: ` PLAN `, ` SIGNALS `, ` LOG `, ` NOTICED ` are inverse chips; the title and NEEDS YOU are slabs to the right edge. Footer: active tab is an inverse chip ` 1 OVERVIEW `, hotkeys dim, labels uppercase; the Needs-you tab carries the count as the code does today (`n NEEDS YOU 1`).
spacingRules: Grid: a 3-cell gutter [space, glyph, space] on every row, text starts at col 3; the gutter is never painted, so a slab or chip never touches the gutter glyph (one cell of air between them). Slabs (title, NEEDS YOU) run from col 3 to the right edge with the label flush at col 3; chips (` PLAN `, ` SIGNALS `, ` 1 OVERVIEW `) start at col 2 so their one-cell pad takes the gutter's trailing cell and the label still lands at col 3. Right column: a hard LEFT edge at col 60 (columns−12), 12 cells wide, left-aligned, so shas, agent+time, counts, ages and the gate command all start on one line; the middle text clips at col 57 so at least 2 cells separate it from the right column; an agent entry appends its tool word only when `model age tool` fits the 12 cells (`opus 6m Edit`, but `sonnet 1m`, never `sonnet 1m E…`), with `truncate-end` as the backstop. Meter row: cols 1–57, count at col 60. Signals: a 6-wide label column at col 3 (`gate  `, `git   `, `ctx   `), values at col 9, secondary numbers (52s, 6 today, $4.10) in the right column. Sections: exactly one blank line, then the chip or slab, then rows with no blank after it; the footer is preceded by one blank line. Band: the outer spaces in the mock are the Box's `paddingX={1}`, so the segment content is 98 cells at 100 columns and 58 at 60; health, count and meter form one unit with single-space gaps; every other segment is two spaces from its neighbour, no middots, metadata dim; the right-pinned counts are two spaces apart. Never adjacent: two slabs or chips (there is at most one per row), a slab and a gutter glyph, a title and its metadata (always ≥2 cells), a row and the next section (always one blank line).
desktopNotes: Proportional font, so alignment never relies on spaces: slabs and chips become a `Box backgroundColor` (`#e8e8e8` for plain, `#ffcf00` for NEEDS YOU) with the label `Text color="#101010"` pinned on both themes, `flexGrow` for slabs and `alignSelf="flex-start"` for chips; every row is a flex row with a `flexGrow` spacer and a right `Box width={12}` whose Text wraps `truncate-end`, so the right column still forms a straight left edge if the fixed width is honoured, and still right-aligns if it is not (open check, see feasibility); the meter is a fixed run of 20 `█`/`░` glyphs (block glyphs are uniform width in any font) or a static `Svg` rect pair where Svg is available; the doing glyph is a static `▓`; the band is not drawn in VS Code. Mobile is the same page with the right column dropping the tool word (`opus 6m`, not `opus 6m Edit`) and Buttons drawn as `[ PER SEAT ]` with "Reply in chat" in place of the Input.

animation.idea: The doing block breathes: the `▓` in the doing row's gutter cycles ░ ▒ ▓ █ ▓ ▒ while an agent is running on that step. When the step is marked done it snaps to `█` and the meter's new cell snaps from `░` to `█` on the next redraw; nothing else moves.
animation.trigger: A running agent on the doing step starts the breathing; a step marked done ends it with the snap; a gate pass only reveals the ✓ (no motion); nothing animates when no agent is running, when the run is finished or paused, or on a `!`/`✗` health.
animation.cadence: 2 fps (500 ms per frame) when the terminal is idle; held at `▓` while the person has typed in the last 2 s; 0 fps (static) on desktop, VS Code and mobile.
animation.staticFrame: `▓` in the doing row's gutter and the meter as drawn in the mock; the static frame is the normal pane.

feasibility: Accent slabs: `{accent}{inverse}` in the mock is implemented as `Text backgroundColor="#ffcf00" color="#101010"` (a fixed dark foreground), not as `inverse`, because inverse of accent text would print the terminal's background colour on yellow (white on yellow on light themes). Plain slabs and chips are `Text inverse` with the label `padEnd` to the width (slabs) or padded by one cell each side (chips) in the terminal; on desktop/mobile they are `Box backgroundColor="#e8e8e8"` with `Text color="#101010"`, because padding with spaces does not hold in a proportional font and because theme `text` on a fixed grey is illegible on one of the two themes. Band `? 1`: unchanged from today (warning bold glyph Text + plain count Button), so no Button has to carry a background. Band health: a plain `Text` with a background, not a Button, so it needs nothing new. Breathing glyph: a 1×1 `Client` must sit inline in a flex row's gutter; if an inline Client cannot be placed in the row, the fallback is the static `▓` (not a `state tick` at 1 fps, which would blink). Right column: `Box width={12}` after a `flexGrow` spacer with `wrap="truncate-end"` on the Text and a fit rule for the tool word, so a 14-cell entry can never wrap the row; whether a fixed Box width is honoured in the desktop's proportional layout is an open check: if it is not, the `flexGrow` spacer alone still right-aligns the column, which keeps rows single-line but loses the straight left edge there. Hover: `subtle` theme key on a keyed Box, no hex. All glyphs used (█ ▓ ▒ ░ ▌ ✓ ✗ ? ! ~ ·) are width-1 BMP.
implementationNotes:
- `GLYPH`/`TONE` maps (view.tsx top): `{todo:'░', doing:'▓', done:'█', blocked:'!', skipped:'·'}`, tones `undefined` except `blocked:'error'`; `dimColor` on the todo glyph and on done/skipped titles, `bold` on the doing glyph and title; `chips()` uses `█`/`▌`/`░`; `healthOf()` returns `▌ ! ✗ █` with tones success/error/error/success; `drawBand` wraps only `!` and `✗` in a 3-cell slab (`Text backgroundColor="#ffcf00" color="#101010"` for `!`, `Text inverse color="error"` for `✗`) and draws `▌`/`█` as plain tone Text; the pane header draws all four as plain tone Text in the gutter.
- `meter()`: `█`/`░`; the pane meter is its own header row sized `columns − 15` (band stays 10) and loses `color="success"`; the header title row becomes ` ! ` in the gutter followed by a `Text inverse` slab padded from col 3 to the width with `elapsed` placed at col 60; a second row carries branch and `doc.meta.gate`.
- `rule()` splits into `chip(label)` (`Text inverse` ` LABEL `, used for PLAN, SIGNALS, LOG, NOTICED, DETAILS) and `slab(label, tail, accent?)` (title and NEEDS YOU: `Text inverse` or `backgroundColor="#ffcf00" color="#101010"` with `label.padEnd(columns − 15) + tail.padEnd(12)`, so the slab's tail sits on the same col-60 edge as every other row); the existing non-mono branch becomes a `Box backgroundColor="#e8e8e8"`/`"#ffcf00"` with `Text color="#101010"`; delete the `─`.repeat and `ruleParts`; the PLAN chip strip is plain Text in the right column.
- Right column: in `stepRow`, `needsBlock`, `signalsBlock` and the header, replace `<Text dimColor> {right}</Text>` with `<Box flexGrow={1} /><Box width={12}><Text dimColor wrap="truncate-end">{right}</Text></Box>` and clip the middle label at `columns − 17` (55 cells from col 3, so two cells of air stay before col 60); the agent entry appends `lastTool` only when `${model} ${age} ${tool}`.length ≤ 12 (replacing the `columns >= 52` guard); drop the `step.status === 'doing'` guard so `agentOf` (which already finds running agents on any step) shows `sonnet 1m` on B5; needs rows move the drift age into that column and show `blocks B4` for a decision; `?`/`!`/`~` stay plain warning/error Text in the gutter as today.
- `signalsBlock`: three rows on a 6-wide label column (`gate`, `git`, `ctx`) with the secondary numbers (duration, commits today, cost) in the right column instead of ` · ` separators; `bandSegments` separators become two spaces (health, count, bar keep one) and the `? n` / `~ n` right segments stay exactly as today.
- Footer: labels uppercase, hotkey as a dim `Text` chip inside each plain Button, active tab a `<Text inverse> 1 OVERVIEW </Text>` chip, the row indented two cells so labels land at col 3; a `Client` of one cell in the doing row's gutter runs the breathing frames with `every(500, …)`, pausing on key events, and is replaced by a static `▓` when `!mono`; hover on step/needs rows uses `backgroundColor="subtle"`.
